assign.request: Make the smallest vertical slice run end to end on the local Cloudflare harness: one topic world, one page inside it, one signed-in user, one like. Write run.md a cold reader can follow; show it on /imagine/platform/mvp/; update the hub's Where this stands; record a decision at decisions/slice.md.
assign.now: scoping - reading the brief, the decisions and the worker
steps: Read the brief, decisions, mvp and worker
Run what exists and prove which parts work
Build the missing piece (the like: D1 table, API, button)
Run the whole slice start to finish and time it
Show it on /imagine/platform/mvp/ with a screenshot

log.msg: THE MVP PAGE WINS, AND IT DIFFERS. /imagine/platform/mvp/ defines the slice as ten steps (0-9); the word 'like' appears nowhere in it. Its step 1 = one topic that is only pages, step 4 = identity (THE LINE), step 5 = one writable surface (a room, text only). So three of the brief's four nouns are the page's steps 1 and 4; the fourth noun, the like, is not an mvp step at all - the nearest ruling is decisions/data.md's Phase 2, 'a Worker + D1 the day a stranger must write (identity, likes)'. Building the like as the fourth noun therefore proves the D1 WRITE path, which nothing has proven yet (the room proved the DO write path on 2026-09-04). Recorded in decisions/slice.md.

PROVED BY RUNNING, not reading: three of the four nouns already work. wrangler dev -c wrangler.dev.jsonc --port 8201 came up in ~1s; /api/me anonymous returns {anonymous:true}; /api/dev/login?as=carol 302s with a signed HttpOnly cookie; /api/me with that cookie returns {handle:carol,roles:[member]}; the topic world and a page inside it are served by the assets binding (200). The like was the only missing noun.

A REAL BUG, FOUND AND FIXED: D1 enforces foreign keys. worker/seed.sql opened with DELETE FROM users, which fails with SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_FOREIGNKEY the moment one like row exists - so the SECOND npm run dev after anybody liked anything would have died before the harness started. seed.sql is now an ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE upsert, verified idempotent with a like present. Bonus, and it is the point: likes now SURVIVE a restart, which is the whole difference between a D1 row and a browser store().
